body:
## Summary

Add an explicitly opt-in AArch64 Grain/JIT experiment while keeping the
publishable gpui-rhai crate independent of fork-only Rhai APIs.

- Scalar native lane for unit/bool/i64/f64 and mixed numeric control flow.
- Managed native-control lane for strings, maps, arrays, function pointers and
  registered host values without reading `Dynamic`'s private layout.
- Named entry/imported/reentrant calls, retained-callback budgets, pinned code
  ownership, bounded caches and no retry after effects begin.
- Adaptive hotness/type specialization and profitability-based Grain fallback;
  no application function allow-list.

## Published crate boundary

The published `gpui-rhai` package continues to depend on official crates.io
Rhai 1.26.0. Its optional `experimental-backend` feature exposes only two
generation-bound traits and an opaque operation observer, all built from
official Rhai/std types. Enabling the feature alone leaves execution on AST.

Every concrete Grain/fork symbol now lives in the `publish = false`
`rhai-jit-experiment` crate behind its optional `gpui-adapter` feature. The
workspace pins [eddix/rhai `jit`](https://github.com/eddix/rhai/tree/jit) at
`989efd986d05ce9799ab2d0472ef7f697d022316`; the fork's default branch is
unchanged and the fork is not published to crates.io. Opt-in applications must
repeat the root Rhai patch because Cargo patches do not propagate.

The previous `vendor/rhai` tree and `grain-backend` feature are removed. The
branch history was rebuilt on current `main` so vendored source is not retained
as an ancestor of the merge. Net PR scope is 33 files rather than 168.

CI verifies `cargo package -p gpui-rhai --locked --all-features`, which extracts
the package outside the workspace Git patch and compiles every advertised
feature against official Rhai.

## Review changes

- **Published all-feature build:** fixed by the fork-independent core boundary;
  all-feature package verification passes against official Rhai.
- **Component timing double-count/default overhead:** the inclusive
  `ComponentRender` timing stream and its clock/allocation/`RefCell` work are
  removed. Default timing fields and aggregation are back to current `main`.
  Imported-function profiling remains in the experiment tier.
- **Stale documentation:** execution/backend architecture, release checklist,
  audit, integration guide, dogfooding limits and Rhai branch ownership now
  describe one current model.
- Rebased onto `main@a38e301`.

## Validation

Local AArch64 macOS:

- Workspace all-feature suite: **384 passed**.
- Pinned Rhai `jit` Grain suite: **131 passed**, one unrelated test filtered.
- Adapter integrations: nested Grain routing and imported component render
  native execution both pass.
- Strict workspace Clippy, formatting, diff checks and rustdoc pass.
- Clean all-feature gpui-rhai package verification against official Rhai passes;
  its package contains no vendor/JIT/dynasm source or dependency.
- The independent default-path performance workspace builds with official Rhai
  and passes its enabled end-to-end preparation test. Its numeric benchmark is
  intentionally run only through `scripts/benchmark.sh`.
- A release multi-type probe after moving to the new Rhai branch preserves value
  parity and executes scalar/managed lanes. Historical repeatable measurements
  remain separately documented rather than being overwritten by one migration
  sanity run.

## Evidence and limits

Recorded release probes found 17.06–17.35x for the numeric sample and 7.49–8.02%
lower object-processing time; forced host-heavy native execution regressed
3.19–4.34%, so the adaptive policy demotes it. A tiny helper still exposes
adaptive routing overhead. These are microbenchmarks, not application promises.

The first omb debug dogfood reported 28/28 assertions in default and JIT modes.
Its real UI specialization compiled and ran, then became `unprofitable`; no
release whole-application gain was established.

x86, disk caches, background compilation, general OSR/deoptimization,
arbitrary capturing closures, JIT debugger stepping and complete Rhai
language/configuration coverage remain outside this experiment.

References:

- `docs/rhai-execution-backends.md`
- `docs/jit-multitype.md`
- `docs/jit-multitype-results.md` and `.json`
- `docs/jit-dogfooding-2026-09-03.md`

Keep the source branch after merge: it remains an active experiment branch.
title: feat: add opt-in adaptive Grain JIT experiment
